name: list_objects
description: List the SObjects this org exposes, with their record counts.

name: get_username
description:
The username of the org this server is connected to.

        The simulator serves one org, so the official tool's org-selection
        arguments are accepted for client compatibility and do not change the
        answer. The user named is the org's own — the one its records are owned
        by — so an agent that asks who it is and then reads ``Owner.Username``
        is told about one person.

defaultDevHub.description: Use the org's default Dev Hub.
defaultDevHub.title: Defaultdevhub

name: run_soql_query
description:
Run a SOQL query against a Salesforce org.

        Returns the same ``{totalSize, done, records}`` envelope as the REST
        ``/services/data/vXX.X/query`` endpoint. A result longer than one page
        comes back with ``done: false`` and a ``queryLocator`` (and the matching
        ``nextRecordsUrl``); pass that locator back — with the same query — to
        read the next page, the way a REST client follows ``nextRecordsUrl``.
        ``useToolingApi`` routes the query at the Tooling API's half of the
        schema, exactly as ``/services/data/vXX.X/tooling/query`` does: Apex,
        debug logs, trace flags and the schema entities answer there, and an
        ordinary data object does not. The simulator serves one org out of one
        store, so ``usernameOrAlias`` and ``directory`` are accepted for client
        compatibility and do not change the result.

usernameOrAlias.description: Username or alias used for compatibility.
usernameOrAlias.title: Usernameoralias

useToolingApi.description: Run against the Tooling API schema.
useToolingApi.title: Usetoolingapi

queryLocator.description: Locator returned for the next query page.
queryLocator.title: Querylocator

name: get_record
description:
Fetch one record by SObject and id (e.g. ``Account`` / ``acct-0``).

        ``fields`` narrows the answer to the fields named, which is how to read
        one value off a wide object without pulling the whole row.

fields.description: Fields to return; omit for the full readable record.
fields.title: Fields

name: list_records
description:
List records of an SObject, newest ids first as stored, with paging.

        ``fields`` projects each row down to the fields named (``["Id", "Name"]``),
        so a listing of a wide object stays small; omitting it returns every field.

fields.description: Fields to return; omit for the full readable records.
fields.title: Fields

name: get_related_records
description:
Traverse a record's relationship, e.g. ``Account`` / ``acct-0`` / ``Contacts``.

        The REST ``/sobjects/{Object}/{id}/{Relationship}`` sub-resource: a child
        relationship answers the ``{totalSize, done, records}`` envelope, a
        parent relationship (``Account``, ``Owner``) the single parent record.
        Relationship names come from ``describe_object``.

relationship_name.description: Relationship name or slash-separated A/B chain.
relationship_name.title: Relationship Name

name: list_list_views
description: The saved list views an object exposes, by developer name.

name: run_list_view
description: Run a saved list view by developer name or id and return its records.

name: read_apex
description: Apex source in the org: every class or trigger, or one by name.

name.description: Apex class or trigger name; omit for all.
name.title: Name

kind.description: Read an Apex class or trigger.
kind.title: Kind

name: get_debug_logs
description: List recent debug logs, or return one log's full body by id.

log_id.description: Debug log id; omit to list recent logs.
log_id.title: Log Id

name: get_updated_records
description:
Ids of records changed in a window, for incremental sync.

        Mirrors REST ``/sobjects/{Object}/updated``; ``start`` and ``end`` are
        ISO-8601 timestamps (``2024-01-01T00:00:00Z``).

name: get_deleted_records
description:
Records deleted in a window, for incremental sync.

        Mirrors REST ``/sobjects/{Object}/deleted``: the rows the org's recycle
        bin still holds, each with the date it was deleted.

name: get_org_limits
description:
Org limits, plus per-object record counts when objects are named.

        The REST ``/limits`` and ``/limits/recordCount`` payloads in one answer,
        which is what an agent sizing an export asks for.

object_names.description: SObject API names to count; omit for no counts.
object_names.title: Object Names

name: describe_object
description:
Field-level metadata for an SObject: types, picklist values, relationships.

        The same body REST ``/sobjects/{Object}/describe`` returns, so a client
        that reads a describe flag (``createable``, ``keyPrefix``,
        ``recordTypeInfos``, a child relationship's ``cascadeDelete``) sees the
        same schema whichever surface it asked.

name: search_records
description: Full-text search across SObjects, the SOSL way (``FIND {term}``).

term.description: Text to find across returned SObjects.
term.title: Term

objects.description: SObject API names; omit for the default set.
objects.title: Objects

name: list_reports
description: List the saved reports this org exposes.

name: run_report
description: Run a saved report and return its Analytics API payload.
